headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Kyle O'Reilly announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.22 ? a match that delivered. Reunited with former Undisputed Era stablemates, O'Reilly's in-ring AEW debut saw the trio brawl their way through a chaotic tag match ? a superkick miscue on Cassidy inadvertently took out Adam Cole, but O'Reilly and Fish still found a way to steal the win.
Looking back to 2023, when Beretta, Cassidy & Romero skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.76.
On a Friday in 2023, back when it was a welcome sight as Marina Shafir returned to the ring after just under 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2021, Christian Cage made their return to AEW television after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
